def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

lib='''
def full_lines(grid):
    """Indices of rows and of columns that are one color throughout, as (rows, cols)."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return rows, cols

def runs_between(n, seps):
    """Contiguous index runs of range(n) excluding the given separator indices."""
    out, cur = [], []
    for i in range(n):
        if i in seps:
            if cur: out.append(cur); cur = []
        else:
            cur.append(i)
    if cur: out.append(cur)
    return out

def block_mark(grid, mark_color=1, count=2):
    """Split at one-color separator rows/cols; each block becomes one cell: mark_color if it holds exactly count cells of the block's least common non-separator color, else that color."""
    rows, cols = full_lines(grid)
    sep = {grid[i][0] for i in rows} | {grid[0][j] for j in cols}
    rgs = runs_between(len(grid), rows)
    cgs = runs_between(len(grid[0]), cols)
    vals = [v for row in grid for v in row if v not in sep]
    bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
    out = []
    for rs in rgs:
        line = []
        for cs in cgs:
            cells = [grid[i][j] for i in rs for j in cs]
            mins = [c for c in set(cells) if c not in sep and c != bg]
            c0 = min(mins, key=lambda c: cells.count(c)) if mins else None
            line.append(mark_color if c0 is not None and cells.count(c0) == count else bg)
        out.append(line)
    return out
